offering_description.value: Provides casino management services in Kansas and modifies, maintains and outfits business and corporate aircraft for owners and operators. Casino services are provided under management contracts, and aviation work is done under FAA-certified repair and modification processes.

primary_products.value: aircraft interior completions; avionics installations; aircraft modification kits; casino gaming operations

primary_services.value: casino management; aircraft maintenance and repair; aircraft modification engineering

customer_segment.value: B2B: business jet owners and operators, aircraft manufacturers and dealers; B2C: casino gaming patrons in Kansas

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: management fees for running casino operations under contract; product sales: avionics and aircraft interior products; service fees: aircraft maintenance, repair and modification work
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: operates casino and maintenance services for owners, sold to casino owners and aircraft operators; OEM / manufacturer: builds aircraft modifications and interior completions, sold to aircraft owners and dealers

geography_served.value: US national: Kansas casino operations, aviation customers across the United States

specialization.value: diversified: separate casino management and aerospace businesses with different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sold directly to aircraft owners, operators and dealers; other: casino management contracts with the casino owner

regulatory_exposure.value: high: gaming licensing by Kansas gaming regulators, FAA certification for repair and modification work

notes: Segment revenue mix and exact current scope are uncertain; descriptions are based on general knowledge.
